q: A buyer wants our emissions reduction plan with dates. What should it contain?
title: Reduction plan with dates for a buyer
short: Start from your measured baseline year. List the actions you will take, each with a date, the expected cut in tonnes and how you will measure it: solar, fuel switch, efficient motors, compressed air fixes. Add a target for a year like 2030 and report progress against it every year.
audience: Suppliers asked for decarbonisation plans by brands and OEMs

ul: Actions with dates and expected tonnes.
How progress will be measured and shared.

p: Actions you have budgets for beat a long list. Buyers check last year's promises against this year's figures.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
